'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Kremenchuk shopping mall attack]]
****Two missiles strike a crowded mall in the city of [[Kremenchuk]], killing at least 13 people and injuring at least 50 others. [[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that more than a thousand people were in the mall at time of the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-hit-crowded-shopping-mall-central-ukraine-zelenskiy-2022-06-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/27/russia-ukraine-live-news-kyiv-asks-for-modern-air-defence-system-liveblog (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Governor of Luhansk Oblast]] claims that a Russian strike in [[Lysychansk]] killed eight civilians who were collecting water and injured 21 others. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/8-killed-in-russian-strike-in-east-ukraine-city-lysychansk-governor-3106328 (NDTV)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russian debt default]]
**[[Russia]] defaults on two [[Taiwan]]ese-owned [[Eurobond (external bond)|Eurobonds]] worth [[US$]]100 million after [[International sanctions during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Western sanctions on Russia]] led [[Euroclear]] to block Russian attempts to service the debt before yesterday's deadline. Russia describes the default as artificially manufactured and "a farce". The default will have few immediate consequences for Russia since the country is currently unable to borrow internationally due to the [[SWIFT ban against Russian banks]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russia-slides-towards-default-payment-deadline-expires-2022-06-26/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-61929926 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Aqaba toxic gas leak]]
**Twelve people are killed and 251 others injured by a toxic [[gas leak]] in the port of [[Aqaba]], [[Jordan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/four-dead-70-injured-toxic-gas-leak-jordans-aqaba-port-state-tv-2022-06-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Missouri train derailment]]
**An [[Amtrak]] ''[[Southwest Chief]]'' [[passenger train]] carrying 243 passengers collides with a [[dump truck]] near [[Mendon, Missouri|Mendon]], [[Missouri]], [[United States]]. Eight cars and two [[locomotives]] are subsequently [[Derailment|derailed]], killing three people and injuring at least 50 others. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/27/us/missouri-amtrak-train-derailment/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.ksn.com/news/state-regional/amtrak-derails-in-missouri-multiple-injuries-reported/ (KSNW-TV)]
*[[2022 San Antonio trailer deaths]]
**At least 51 people are found dead inside a [[tractor-trailer]] in [[San Antonio]], [[Texas]], United States. Sixteen others are transported to hospitals. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/27/us/san-antonio-migrants-found-truck/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 Japan heatwave]]
**The [[Japanese government]] asks the public to conserve energy and to prepare for power outages as the country faces a [[heat wave]]. [https://apnews.com/article/climate-politics-tokyo-weather-heat-waves-333e88b793e91646af19be55ad8c8d91 (AP)]
*One person is killed and five others injured after a bullet train [[train wreck|collides]] with an engine in [[Bohumin]], [[Czech Republic]]. [https://apnews.com/article/prague-czech-republic-accidents-a562ad4c52e42ebdd6b99c0b30cff100 (AP)]
*Four people are injured when an apartment roof collapses in [[Budapest]], [[Hungary]]. [https://apnews.com/article/hungary-budapest-structural-failures-9a528a73db34f4ccd3b8092b1f9b7b41 (AP)]
*One person is killed and ten others injured after a [[tornado]] hits [[Zierikzee]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tornadoes-storms-sports-e8d5702fd9a96e38e27f03f8fbf28049 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Europe]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports almost one hundred new cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/InfAZ/A/Affenpocken/Ausbruch-2022-Situation-Deutschland.html (RKI Deutsche)]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] reports more than forty new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.rivm.nl/monkeypox-apenpokken (RIVM Netherlands)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[Minnesota]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.fox9.com/news/minnesota-reports-first-case-of-monkeypox (KMSP-TV)]
**[[Peru]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.bernama.com/en/world/news.php?id=2094938 (Bernama)]
**The [[World Health Organization]] confirms the first death caused by the 2022 monkeypox outbreak. [https://www.who.int/news/item/25-06-2022-meeting-of-the-international-health-regulations-(2005)-emergency-committee--regarding-the-multi-country-monkeypox-outbreak (WHO)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nauru]]
***[[Nauru]] surpasses 2,000 COVID-19 cases amid an outbreak and emergency declared by [[President of Nauru|President]] [[Lionel Aingimea]]. [https://www.loopnauru.com/nauru-news/nauru-covid-19-cases-now-over-2000-113719 (Loop Nauru)]

'''International relations'''
*[[48th G7 summit]]
**World leaders at the [[Group of Seven|G7]] summit in [[Germany]] issue a statement pledging more [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|financial]], humanitarian, military and diplomatic support to [[Ukraine]]. This comes after [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] issued a video calling for more heavy weapons from allies. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-61954445 (BBC News)]
  
'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**[[Abortion in Louisiana]], [[Abortion in Utah]]
***State judges in [[New Orleans]] and in [[Utah]] temporarily block the [[abortion]] bans for all stages of pregnancy that state officials announced after the [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court]]'s ruling in ''[[Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization]]''. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/jun/27/louisiana-judge-abortion-ban-roe-v-wade-supreme-court (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.deseret.com/utah/2022/6/27/23185611/judge-issues-temporary-restraining-utah-abortion-ban-lawsuit-planned-parenthood (''Deseret'')]
**[[Abortion in South Carolina]]
***A federal judge in [[South Carolina]] lifts an injunction on the so-called [[heartbeat bill]], effectively limiting abortion to about six weeks into pregnancy. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/abortion-ban-south-carolina-court-rules-law-can-go-into-effect/ (CBS News)]
*One person is killed and five others injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a shelter for [[Asylum seeker|asylum-seekers]] in [[Kressbronn]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-migration-db851d69446f8f2a18ddbc5cf9235b4b (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 Rugby World Cup qualifying]]
**[[World Rugby]] rejects the [[Spanish Rugby Federation]]'s appeal against [[Spain national rugby union team|their national team]]'s disqualification in the [[2023 Rugby World Cup]] for fielding an ineligible player during the qualifying tournament, thus confirming [[Romania national rugby union team|Romania]]'s qualification to the World Cup by taking Spain's berth as [[2023 Rugby World Cup – Europe qualification|Europe 2]]. [https://today.rtl.lu/sport/international/a/1933745.html (RTL)]
